subject: Biology
title: Locomotion and Movement
summary: Cells teen tarah ki movement dikhate hain: amoeboid (pseudopodia — macrophages, leucocytes), ciliary (trachea, fallopian tubes) aur muscular (limbs, jaws, tongue). Locomotion voluntary movement hai jo jagah badalti hai.

Skeletal muscle fibres se bani hai jinmein repeat hone wale sarcomeres hain (actin thin filaments aur myosin thick filaments). Sliding filament theory contraction samjhaati hai, jo Ca²⁺ se trigger aur ATP se powered hai.
Human skeleton mein 206 bones: axial (80) aur appendicular (126). Joint fibrous, cartilaginous ya synovial hote hain.
Muscles aur bones ke disorders: myasthenia gravis, muscular dystrophy, tetany, arthritis, osteoporosis aur gout.

formulas.name: Sarcomere
formulas.formula: functional unit of contraction = between two successive Z lines;  I band (light, actin only) and A band (dark, myosin);  H zone (centre of A band, no overlap);  M line holds thick filaments

formulas.name: Changes during contraction
formulas.formula: I band shortens, H zone shortens/disappears, A band length stays the same, sarcomere shortens
formulas.mistake: Filaments chhote nahi hote — ek doosre par slide karte hain; galat mat likhna.

formulas.name: Contractile proteins
formulas.formula: actin (thin filament) + tropomyosin + troponin;  myosin (thick filament — meromyosin: heavy (head, with ATPase, actin binding site) and light (tail))

formulas.name: Excitation–contraction
formulas.formula: motor neuron releases acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction → action potential → Ca²⁺ released from sarcoplasmic reticulum → Ca²⁺ binds troponin → myosin binding sites on actin exposed → cross-bridge → power stroke (ATP hydrolysis)

formulas.name: Red vs white fibres
formulas.formula: red: much myoglobin and mitochondria, aerobic;  white: little myoglobin, fewer mitochondria, many sarcoplasmic reticulum, anaerobic

formulas.name: Axial skeleton
formulas.formula: skull 22 (cranial 8 + facial 14) + hyoid 1 + ear ossicles 6 + vertebral column 26 + sternum 1 + ribs 24 (12 pairs)

formulas.name: Vertebral column
formulas.note: Lagbhag saare mammals, giraffe aur insaan samet, mein 7 cervical vertebrae hote hain.

formulas.name: Ribs
formulas.formula: true ribs: pairs 1–7 (attached to sternum directly);  false ribs (vertebrochondral): pairs 8–10 (joined to the 7th rib's cartilage);  floating ribs: pairs 11–12

formulas.name: Appendicular skeleton
formulas.formula: each limb 30 bones;  forelimb: humerus, radius, ulna, 8 carpals, 5 metacarpals, 14 phalanges;  hind limb: femur (longest), tibia, fibula, 7 tarsals, 5 metatarsals, 14 phalanges, patella;  pectoral girdle: clavicle + scapula;  pelvic girdle: coxal bones (ilium, ischium, pubis)

formulas.name: Joints
formulas.formula: fibrous (immovable — skull sutures);  cartilaginous (limited movement — between vertebrae);  synovial (free movement): ball and socket (humerus–pectoral girdle), hinge (knee), pivot (atlas–axis), gliding (carpals), saddle (carpal–metacarpal of thumb)

formulas.name: Muscle and bone disorders
formulas.formula: myasthenia gravis (autoimmune, affects neuromuscular junction);  muscular dystrophy (genetic degeneration);  tetany (low Ca²⁺ → rapid spasms);  arthritis (joint inflammation);  osteoporosis (age, low oestrogen — bone mass falls);  gout (uric acid crystals in joints)

examples.title: Kul bones
examples.problem: Axial skeleton mein 80 bones aur appendicular mein 126. Kul?

examples.title: Axial ginti check
examples.problem: Skull (22), hyoid (1), ear ossicles (6), vertebrae (26), sternum (1) aur ribs (24) jodo.

examples.title: Bands mein badlaav
examples.problem: Contraction mein kaunsa band utna hi lamba rehta hai?
examples.solution: A band (moti myosin filaments ki lambai). Actin andar slide hone se I band aur H zone chhote hote hain.

examples.title: Calcium ka role
examples.problem: Muscle contraction mein Ca²⁺ kya karta hai?
examples.solution: Troponin se judta hai, jo tropomyosin ko khiskaata hai aur actin par myosin-binding sites khol deta hai, jisse cross-bridges ban paate hain.

examples.title: Thakaan
examples.problem: Baar-baar contraction ke baad muscles thak kyun jaati hain?
examples.solution: Glycogen ke anaerobic breakdown se muscle mein lactic acid jama hota hai.

examples.title: Joint ka type
examples.problem: Atlas aur axis ke beech kaunsa joint hai, aur kaunsi movement deta hai?

topics.title: Types of muscle
topics.explain: Skeletal (striated, voluntary — locomotion aur posture), visceral/smooth (non-striated, involuntary — gut, reproductive tract ki walls mein), cardiac (striated, involuntary, branched).

topics.title: Structure of skeletal muscle
topics.explain: Muscle bundles (fascicles) fascia se bandhe; har muscle fibre ek syncytium hai jisme sarcolemma, sarcoplasm aur sarcoplasmic reticulum (Ca²⁺ store). Myofibrils mein baari-baari dark (anisotropic, A) aur light (isotropic, I) bands.

topics.title: Cross-bridge cycle
topics.explain: ADP + Pi wala myosin head actin se judta hai, unhe chhodkar power stroke mein actin ko centre ki taraf kheenchta hai; naya ATP head ko chhudaata hai, ATP hydrolyse hota hai aur head phir taiyaar. Ca²⁺ waapas pump hone par sites phir dhak jaati hain aur muscle relax.

topics.title: Skull
topics.explain: Cranium mein 8 bones (brain ki raksha); face mein 14 bones. Hyoid U-shaped, buccal cavity ke base par. Skull do occipital condyles se vertebral column se judta hai (dicondylic skull).

topics.title: Vertebral column and sternum
topics.explain: Pehla vertebra atlas hai, jo occipital condyles se judta hai. Column spinal cord ki raksha karta, sir ko sahara deta aur ribs aur peeth ki muscles jodta hai. Sternum thorax ki ventral midline par flat bone hai.

topics.title: Girdles
topics.explain: Pectoral girdle: clavicle (collar bone) aur scapula (humerus ke head ke liye glenoid cavity, acromion process). Pelvic girdle: do coxal bones, har ek ilium, ischium aur pubis ke judne se; acetabulum mein thigh bone fit hoti hai; dono aadhe pubic symphysis par milte hain.

ratta: A band constant; I band & H zone shorten.
Ca²⁺ binds troponin;  ACh at neuromuscular junction.
Pivot: atlas–axis;  hinge: knee;  saddle: thumb;  ball-socket: shoulder.
Gout = uric acid;  tetany = low Ca²⁺;  myasthenia = autoimmune.
